headline: Housing also rises by neighborhood: from 2,715 euros/m² in Ciudad Jardín to 4,990 in the Este district
summary: Housing prices in Málaga vary by neighbourhood, from €2,715 per square metre in Ciudad Jardín to €4,990 in the Este district. The province is more than €3,400 per square metre above Jaén, the cheapest in the region.
why: Residential property prices reflect local demand, financing conditions and supply, and they feed into household wealth and mortgage markets.
